City of Encinitas
Environmental Commission Meeting
AGENDA
MAY 14, 2020 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
Pursuant to the State of California Executive Order n-29-20 and the amended County Health Order dated March 18, 2020 (limiting gatherings to no more than 10 people), members of the public will only be allowed to participate in meetings remotely.
Oral Communications on non-agenda items and Public Comments on Agenda items must be submitted via email to CleanWater@encinitasca.gov
Oral Communication or Public Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Commission and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes.
Oral Communication or Public Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Commission and made a part of the meeting record.
